targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('hour', created_at) AS time, count(*) AS questions FROM questions WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT status, count(*) AS answers FROM questions WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY status ORDER BY status

panels.title: Estimated cost (USD)
panels.description: Gemini questions only (the offline mock provider costs nothing): tokens times the list price of gemini-3.1-flash-lite, 0.25 USD per million input tokens and 1.50 per million output tokens

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(sum(input_tokens) * 0.25 / 1e6 + sum(output_tokens) * 1.50 / 1e6, 0) AS usd FROM questions WHERE provider = 'gemini' AND $__timeFilter(created_at)

SELECT date_trunc('hour', created_at) AS time, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms) AS p50, percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms) AS p95 FROM questions WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT date_trunc('hour', created_at) AS time, sum(input_tokens) AS input, sum(output_tokens) AS output FROM questions WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: By model and prompt version
panels.description: Compares prompt versions and models: volume, share of questions the document did not cover, and latency

targets.rawSql: SELECT model, prompt_version, count(*) AS questions, round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'not_found') / count(*), 1) AS not_found_pct, round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'unverified') / count(*), 1) AS unverified_pct, round(avg(latency_ms)) AS avg_latency_ms, round(avg(input_tokens + output_tokens)) AS avg_tokens FROM questions WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY model, prompt_version ORDER BY questions DESC
